start: Settings, Your data, Backup and restore, a phone with workouts and a MettleUp backup ZIP saved in Files

user_sees: 'Choose a backup file made by MettleUp or the old ForgeAI app. You see what is inside before anything changes.'
Button 'Choose backup file'
must_not: Anything on the phone changed before a file is chosen

steps.action: Tap 'Choose backup file' and pick the mettleup-backup ZIP
user_sees: Heading 'In this backup'
A summary such as '512 workouts, 9 routines, 40 measurements and 12 photos, saved on 25 Oct 2026 by MettleUp ...'
Buttons 'Replace everything on this phone', 'Add to what's here', 'Choose another file'
must_not: Any workout, routine or setting changed just by opening the file

user_sees: Sheet titled 'Delete N workouts first?' saying the phone's workouts go, how many are not in the backup, and 'A copy is kept while you stay on this screen, so you can undo.'
Button 'Replace'
must_not: The phone's workouts deleted before 'Replace' is tapped

user_sees: 'Putting back 3 of 12 photos...', then 'Putting back your workouts and routines...', then 'Working out your records...'
'Restored N workouts, N routines, N measurements and N photos.'
Button 'Undo restore'
must_not: The phone number or gym link replaced from the file
A half-restored phone when a step fails
Photos already on the phone deleted

start: Same, the member taps 'Add to what's here' instead

user_sees: 'In this backup' summary
Note: 'Add to what's here': only what this phone doesn't have yet comes in; your settings stay.
must_not: Settings or profile changed by opening the file

user_sees: 'Restored N workouts, ... N workouts were already here, so they were left out.'
must_not: A workout already on the phone (same id, same content, or same day and start within 30 minutes) brought in twice
The phone's settings or profile replaced

start: First open of a new phone, welcome screen, a backup ZIP in Files

steps.action: On the welcome screen, use the restore panel and pick the backup ZIP
user_sees: 'In this backup' summary
One button 'Restore' (nothing on the phone to add to)
'Your settings and profile come back too. Photos already on this phone stay.'
must_not: A choice between Replace and Add on an empty phone

user_sees: 'Restored N workouts, ...' and the app opens as the member's own
must_not: A 'Member' profile left behind when the restore fails
An 'Undo restore' button that cannot work from the welcome screen

start: Restore screen, the member picks a file that is not a MettleUp backup (a photo, a Hevy CSV, a ZIP repacked by another app)

steps.action: Pick a photo or any other file
user_sees: 'That file isn't a MettleUp backup, so nothing was changed. Pick the file that starts with "mettleup-backup".'
Button 'Choose backup file' again
must_not: A crash or endless spinner
Anything on the phone changed

steps.action: Pick a backup ZIP that another app packed again (compressed)
user_sees: 'This backup was packed again by another app, so MettleUp can't read it. Use the file exactly as MettleUp saved it. Nothing was changed.'
must_not: The file read in part and restored half-way

steps.action: Pick a backup saved by a newer MettleUp
user_sees: 'This backup was saved by a newer version of MettleUp. Update MettleUp, then restore it again. Nothing was changed.'
must_not: The newer file restored with fields dropped silently

start: Restore screen with a backup chosen, a workout in progress on the phone

steps.action: Tap 'Replace everything on this phone' then 'Replace' (or 'Add to what's here')
user_sees: 'Finish your workout first: finish or discard the workout in progress, then restore.'
must_not: The workout in progress deleted or overwritten

steps.action: Phone short of space for the backup's photos: tap Replace
user_sees: 'Your phone is short of space: this needs about N MB and only N MB is free. Free up some space, then try again. Nothing was changed.'
must_not: Some photos or the profile written before the space check

start: Restore screen, a backup already restored in this visit

steps.action: After 'Restored ...', leave the screen and come back
user_sees: The screen starts again at 'Choose backup file'
No 'Undo restore' button any more
must_not: An old undo copy applied later to a changed phone

steps.action: Restore the same file again with 'Add to what's here'
user_sees: 'Restored 0 workouts ... N workouts were already here, so they were left out.'
must_not: Every workout doubled

start: Member sends the backup ZIP to someone else (WhatsApp, Drive)

user_sees: Workouts, routines, body weight, measurements, photos, profile and settings
must_not: The phone number or the gym membership in the file
Any other member's data in the file

steps.action: Restore that file on another person's phone
user_sees: The other phone gets the workouts; its own phone number and gym link stay as they were
must_not: The receiving phone's gym link, sign-in or membership changed by the file
